'''Jeeval''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Griffon's Wings]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jeeval was [[Death/Legends|killed]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]] during an attack on ''Griffon's Wings'' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Jeeval was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Eschewing a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], a common occupation for many of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Jeeval enlisted in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] resistance movement as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. Assigned to the modified [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Griffon's Wings]]'', serving alongside fellow crew members [[Gorbacca]], [[Talva Ko'lib]], [[Vylanthar Merric]] and [[Kandar Vallan]]. Jeeval participated in several missions and demonstrated his capability, though on occasion he was also in the wrong place at the wrong time, resulting in difficulties for his Rebel colleagues.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

At some stage after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jeeval accompanied ''Griffon's Wings'' on an assignment to survey the isolated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]<ref name="Shadows in the Force" /> in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], to assess the world's suitability as a location for a Rebel base. However, upon its arrival in the [[Yorgraxx system/Legends|Yorgraxx system]], the Rebel transport came under heavy [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire from three [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The barrage shook the Rebel vessel and threw Jeeval into a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] panel. Sustaining serious injury to his head, the Rodian [[Blood/Legends|bled]] profusely and [[Death/Legends|died]] from his wounds. The stricken ''Griffon's Wings'' crashed onto Yorgraxx shortly thereafter.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

==Personality and traits==
Jeeval had a careless nature and was more affable than was common for Rodians.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jeeval was created by [[Robert Wiese]] and appeared in ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that was published by [[RPGA]] in [[2004]] as a tie-in to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />
